Samir: Quick heads-up — Prospect Nimbus wants a short POC to validate swapping from VendorX to Redwood. Main asks: prompt parity, token billing parity, and a security questionnaire answer set. Can we triage?
Elaine: +1. They care about deterministic behavior on a few templates and identical response shapes for our shim. Also need to know if token accounting will map 1:1 to their existing metrics.
Jon P: I can own the parity test harness. Can you share the top 6 prompts and expected outputs? we should run both models and diff.
Samir: pinging the customer thread for prompts. They sent 6 templates and one stateful chat flow that relies on session continuation + short-term KV.
Ori: For stateful flows note: VendorX uses conversation IDs and server-side session merging. Our runtime uses KV caching + client-supplied conversation_id. We need to demo an adapter that accepts VendorX's handshake header and recreates session.
Maria S: Security Qs: they need KMS integration, IP allowlist, SOC2 + audit logs, and retention controls. Also a question about PII redaction in logs.
Jon P: For prompt parity, two known deltas: tokenization differences (VendorX uses BPE/alt tokenizer) and sampling defaults (top-p vs top-k). We'll run tests with deterministic settings: top_k=1, seed fixed.
Elaine: Action items: 1) Jon builds a quick harness and runs 6 prompt diffs. 2) Ori prototypes compatibility header mapping. 3) Maria prepares security answers + diagram. Samir will coordinate with sales/legal.
Samir: Timeline? Nimbus wants a demo this week (Thu preferred). Can we make a minimal POC by Wed EOD?
Jon P: Wed EOD is tight but we can deliver initial diffs and a README. I'll spin up a test with --seed and puppet the sampling configs.
Ori: I can hack the shim — will accept header `X-VendorX-Session` and translate to `conversation_id` + replay last 3 messages into KV. Sample mapping below:
```
# compatibility shim example
POST /v1/compat/generate
Headers: {
  "Authorization": "Bearer <token>",
  "X-VendorX-Session": "abc123",
  "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
Body: {"prompt":"<user prompt>", "max_tokens":512}
```
Shim will: look up session abc123 -> populate KV cache, then call Redwood runtime with `conversation_id` set.
Maria S: For security questionnaire: draft answers ready by Tue noon. Questions to clarify from Nimbus: do they want customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed? Also retention window?
Samir: They prefer customer-managed KMS if possible. Legal will push for it.
devsec-bot: Reminder: Any customer-managed KMS + private deployment requires a dedicated network/workspace. See internal playbook: https://redwood.internal/sec/kms-onboard (internal only).
Elaine: Pricing question — Nimbus asked if token rounding differs. VendorX bills per request rounded up to 50-token buckets. Redwood bills per token. We need to show cost model translation for their historical usage. Can someone run a billing sim?
Jon P: I have a small script to convert VendorX records to per-token estimate. Will run it against the sample dataset they shared and attach numbers in the POC doc.
Ori: Also flag: VendorX sometimes injects `choices[].logprobs` in responses and some clients rely on presence/shape of that field. Our default does not include logprobs. We'll need to show compatibility mode that returns `logprobs: null` or raw scores depending on privacy and perf tradeoffs.
Maria S: Add that to security Qs — whether returning logprobs counts as sensitive model metadata.
Samir: Good catch. Also Nimbus asked about rate-limit semantics: VendorX enforces 120rpm, burst allowed. Redwood's hosted plan uses token-based rate limit plus concurrency. We should document mapping and a stub config they can use.
Elaine: I'll assemble a POC checklist for Thu demo: prompts + diffs, shim demo (curl), pricing slide, security answers, rate-limit mapping, fallback plan (if parity gap > threshold show canary fallback).
Jon P: Example curl for shim demo:
```
curl -X POST https://redwood-demo/compat/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer demo-token"
  -H "X-VendorX-Session: abc123"
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize Q1 revenue in one sentence","max_tokens":80}'
```
Response shape will mimic VendorX for client compatibility.
Ori: I'll include a tiny latency measurement: shim adds ~8-12ms for header translation and KV fetch if cache hit. If cache miss, more. We'll surface that in the demo.
Maria S: Security: confirm we can enable field-level redaction in logs (PII). Answer: yes for Dedicated/Private, hosted needs allowed-redaction config. I'll specify.
Samir: Ok team — please update the POC doc in Confluence under /sales/pocs/nimbus and drop early diffs in this thread. @Jon P @Ori @Maria S — ping me when you post. Thanks! :thumbsup:
